# Literature cross-check: T. rex foot audit (generated by lit_convert.py)

Model frame (main 2e734e29, physics r9, home keyframe; out/model_frame.json): pad -0.010 to 0.130 m about MTP III, centre 0.060 m, half-length 0.070 m; footprint (pad rear to digit III tip) 0.228 m; digit III 0.218 m (MTP to capsule tip).

## Audit rows (published value restated in the model's units)

| Metatarsus / femur (model: ankle-to-MTP III joint distance; published: MT III bone length / femur) | 0.613 (0.2154 / 0.3513 m) | adults 0.523-0.600 (MOR 555 0.523, CM 9380 0.536, RTMP 81.12.1 0.542, BHI 6230 0.600); juvenile LACM 23845 0.616; Sue from Brochu Fig. 100 (digitised MT III 70.4-72.4 cm / femur 131.2 cm) 0.537-0.552 [figure estimate] | Model sits at the juvenile LACM 23845 value and above all adults. | Hallux and claws | no hallux; digit capsules carry contact to the tip, with no separate ungual | MT I attached posteriorly on MT II, digit I 'not reversed', narrow curved ungual (Brochu 2003); hallux impression on one Bellatoripes print only (McCrea 2014); unguals II-III flat-bottomed (Brochu); ostrich claw only at push-off (Schaller 2011), 1.5-2.4% of load (Zhang 2017); ungual = 0.24-0.26 of summed digit III = statistic 1.45 to 2.26 on the model [figure estimate] | Omitting the hallux is consistent with the evidence. Load at the claw zone (statistic > ~+1.5) would be a push-off pattern, not a standing one. | Brochu 2003 text (dl/plazi_brochu2003); McCrea 2014; Schaller 2011; Zhang 2017; out/brochu_pes_summary.json |
| Passive stiffness / mgh | six digit springs 0.323; two ankle servos kp 2.42 (mgh 743.4 N m/rad at home) | human intrinsic ankle stiffness 91 +- 23% (tiny perturbations; Loram & Lakie 2002), 64 +- 8% (1 deg; Casadio 2005) | Rough index only. Digit springs are about half the human passive fraction; the servos are active stiffness, not passive. | out/model_frame.json; Loram & Lakie 2002 + Casadio 2005 abstracts (dl/abstracts) |

## Brochu 2003 pes (FMNH PR 2081), digitised from the published figures

Digit III phalanges, dorsal / ventral view (cm): [22.4, 16.6, 14.3, 16.7] / [21.7, 15.0, 13.2, 17.5]; sum 67.5-70.0.
Digit II: [22.6, 15.9, 19.0] / [21.8, 16.8, 20.3]; digit IV (IV-1..IV-3 only): [15.5, 14.6, 10.1] / [16.2, 13.9, 10.7]; digit I ungual [14.6] / [15.7].
MT III views [72.4, 70.4, 71.1, 72.1] (mean 71.5); MT II [67.6, 69.0, 66.9, 67.5]; MT IV [69.8, 71.6, 69.0, 70.8].
III-1 share 0.320-0.322; III-1+III-2 0.545-0.557; ungual 0.239-0.260; II-1 share of digit II 0.370-0.393; digit II/III sums 0.82-0.87.
